programme.title: Aída
programme.sub-title: Adivina quien no viene a cenar esta noche
programme.desc: Tras la emisión en televisión de un reportaje sobre Esperanza Sur, el barrio de Aída, en el que consideran a la zona como una de las más peligrosas y con menor calidad de vida del país, los vecinos se ponen de acuerdo para mejorar la imagen del lugar mediante un original plan: batir el record Guiness reuniendo al mayor número de personas disfrazadas de Reyes Magos. Para evitar pasar sólo el día de Nochebuena, Chema decide buscar una acompañante femenina con la que compartir dicha jornada. El empresario adquiere un peluquín para parecer más atractivo y cuando sus amigos lo descubren, no cesan de hacerle bromas. Por otra parte, Aída se sorprende cuando Manolo, su ex-marido, le llama para cenar junto a ella y sus hijos en Nochebuena. En un primer momento, la mujer se niega pero ante la pertinaz insistencia de Jonathan y Lorena, acaba accediendo a que Manolo comparta con ellos dicha velada.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un león usurpado, una himenoplastia y una reforma sorpresa
programme.desc: Judith se siente irremediablemente atraída por Aitor, un joven apuesto y conservador. Pero su virginidad y sus fuertes creencias religiosas complicarán el desarrollo de su romance. Además, Fermín, que ve a su hija Lola decidida a reformar su piso, decide llamar al programa 'Reforma por sorpresa'. Asimismo, una fuerte discusión entre Alba y su padre Antonio obliga a la joven transexual a buscar refugio en el piso de Teodoro. La pareja está encantada, pero Amador verá la llegada de su futura cuñada como una intromisión en su hogar.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un coche eléctrico, una chacha literata y una sopa de dedo agridulce
programme.desc: La vida sonríe a los Cuquis: Maite triunfa como escritora de novela erótica, mientras Amador disfruta de su vida como hombre mantenido. Han ascendido en la escala social y finalmente consiguen recuperar a sus hijos.Por su parte, Coque quiere dar un paso más en su relación con Nines y le pide matrimonio, propuesta a la que ella accede siempre que ambos pasen por el altar con una boda por todo lo alto. Tras conocer la noticia, Antonio y Fermín se ofrecen, cada uno por su cuenta, a ayudar al conserje a conseguir un anillo de pedida.Además, Judith, que ya se ha sometido a la operación de reconstrucción de himen, quiere perder su virginidad con alguien especial. Y Enrique Pastor, fiel defensor de los principios ecológicos, estrena coche eléctrico, iniciativa que suscita los celos y la envidia entre los habitantes de Mirador de Montepinar.

programme.title: La que se avecina xs
programme.desc: Peculiares, atípicos y variopintos son los residentes y empleados de 'Mirador de Montepinar', un complejo residencial de nueva planta situado en la periferia de una gran ciudad. Una familia caótica, una pareja de recién casados, una Bridget Jones española y el 'pesado oficial' del vecindario son algunos de los protagonistas de esta nueva serie de Telecinco. En el primer episodio, los nuevos vecinos comienzan a mudarse a 'Mirador de Montepinar'. Javi, el joven presidente de esta comunidad, regresa junto a su esposa Lola de la luna de miel y se encuentra con numerosos problemas: los vecinos no pagan las cuotas, el conserje se ha despedido y la constructora no se pronuncia a la hora de arreglar los desperfectos de la obra. En su misión, le ayuda Leo, el vicepresidente considerado el 'pesado' del edificio. El matrimonio formado por Enrique y Araceli -él concejal y ella dueña de la peluquería de la finca- se trasladan a su nueva residencia junto a Fran, su hijo adolescente, y doña Charo, la madre de Araceli. Pronto se producen las primeras disputas entre este clan, los Pastor-Madariaga, y sus vecinos de arriba, los Recio, un matrimonio paranoico.

programme.title: La que se avecina xs
programme.sub-title: Okupas, flechazos y golpe en el garaje
programme.desc: Tras recibir súplicas de los vecinos, Raquel, la directora comercial de la empresa constructora, acude a Mirador de Montepinar para revisar los desperfectos de las viviendas. En el transcurso de su visita, conoce a Sergio, con quien vive una noche de pasión. Cuando él no quiere saber más de ella, Raquel se niega a arreglar los desperfectos. Entonces, Sergio se verá obligado a volver a conquistar a la directora comercial. Durante la celebración de una junta de vecinos, los Recio obligan a Enrique y Araceli a desmontar las antiestéticas rejas de su terraza. Poco después, Araceli colisiona accidentalmente con el coche de Antonio Recio y tiene miedo que piense que se trata de una venganza. Por otro lado, desconociendo que Javi es un hombre casado, Cris intenta ligar con él en un intento de rehacer su vida sentimental. Además, la nueva vida de Izaskun y Mari Tere como okupas parece peligrar, ya que varias personas han mostrado interés en adquirir el piso piloto de la finca. Por último, en plena guerra con Lola por convertirse en la mujer más importante de su hijo, Goya se empeña en hacerles la colada como a él le gusta, lo que provocará una batalla entre suegra y nuera.

programme.title: A Haunting

programme.title: A Haunting

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Following the breakup of his marriage, Steven LaChance begins to experience strange things inside his house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Selena and her 3-year-old son move into an old house in Michigan, a series of photographs show what she cannot see with the naked eye: an evil face in the attic.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia
programme.desc: Brown bears, wolves, lynx, eagles… where within the European Union are these carnivores still regular inhabitants? Where can you find mountainous regions that yet wait to be discovered by mass tourism.

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Code and the kiln's glow

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, "Fun Guide to China". Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an "Old Dad Tea" restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach...

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun) - a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.desc: What did China's most celebrated scholars and poets eat? This documentary follows the trail of famous cultural figures from ancient to modern times, using reenactments to explore the classic dishes that helped define China’s rich culinary history.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an "Emporium of the World".

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down..

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael.

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You..

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.).

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: Los Simpson
programme.desc: Un inspector de Hacienda descubre que Homer ha defraudado a la agencia tributaria y le da a elegir entre pagar una severa sanción o ayudar al FBI, convirtiéndose así en una herramienta de opresión del gobierno. Su objetivo será el de recuperar para el Estado el único billete de un trillón de dólares existente en el mundo y que fue robado por el Señor Burns durante la Guerra. Homer intenta encontrarlo en su gran mansión, bajo el pretexto de escribir un artículo sobre Burns para una revista.Cuando Homer, finalmente, encuentra el billete, el FBI irrumpe en la mansión para detener al Señor Burns. Sin embargo, Homer frustra el plan del gobierno, huyendo con el billete junto a Smithers y Burns. Los tres deciden abandonar el país con el billete de un trillón de dólares y acaban aterrizando en Cuba, donde intentan comprarle el país a Fidel Castro. Al final, Castro les roba el valioso billete y Homer, Burns y Smithers deben regresar a Springfiled, donde les espera la Justicia.

programme.title: Los Simpson
programme.desc: Lisa es elegida para presentar un informativo televisivo infantil, con la colaboración de Bart, Nelson y Milhouse. Sin embargo, el carisma de Bart llama la atención de los productores, que deciden juntar a los dos hermanos en la tarea de presentación, encontrándose ahora en competencia directa delante y detrás de las cámaras. Un día, después de oír a escondidas a su hermana llamándolo estúpido, Bart acude a Kent Brockman para que le diga cómo ser un buen presentador. Bart empieza a cubrir interesantes historias humanas que le hacen popular y que provocan la envidia en Lisa. Bart intenta mostrarse conmovedor ante los problemas de la gente, así que Lisa idea un plan para desenmascarar su falsedad. Un día, Bart se va a una chatarrería, donde Willie intenta matarlo y Lisa tiene que salvar el programa del día usando la misma retórica falsa que le hizo popular a su hermano.Mientras, Homer adopta a Mojo, un mono ayudante, después de convencer a Marge de que es un entretenimiento para su padre minusválido. Pero, Marge y el mono no se soportan. Después de un tiempo con Homer, el mono adquiere todos sus malos hábitos, se vuelve vago y gordo. Finalmente, Marge obliga a Homer a devolverlo.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Uno de los miembros del jurado encargado de dar su veredicto sobre el juicio por el asesinato de Lila Addison, una habitual de las revistas del corazón, aparece envenenado. Uno de sus compañeros advierte a Castle y Beckett de que el primo del acusado estuvo hablando con la víctima e intimidándola, algo que demuestra la grabación de la cámara de seguridad del juzgado. Por otro lado, Castle se muere de curiosidad porque sabe que Alexis le mintió cuando le dijo que no podía acompañarle al estreno de la adaptación fílmica de su novela.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: El cadáver de un hombre aparece en el horno de la pizzería Authentic Nick. El propietario del local, Ralph, cree que el responsable es uno de sus rivales, los gerentes de locales con nombres tan originales como Terrific Nick, Terrific Authentic Nick y Authentic Terrific Nick. El cadáver pertenece a Gordon Burns, un periodista cuyo editor se entrevista con Castle y Beckett. El hombre, les explica que Burns llevaba mucho tiempo sin escribir porque su hija de diez años había muerto en un accidente de tráfico tiempo atrás, pero que le había encargado un reportaje sobre los conflictos entre los pizzeros de Nueva York.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: El nadador olímpico Zack Lindsey aparece muerto de un disparo en la piscina después de su entrenamiento nocturno. El compañero de Lindsey, Rob Tredwick, había estado con él la noche de su muerte y explica a Castle y Beckett que había roto con su novia hacía muy poco tiempo. Sin embargo, la chica no es una asesina. La pareja recoge pruebas en el apartamento del chico y encuentra una dosis de anabolizantes. El cadáver de Lindsey está limpio, con lo que piensan que es posible que traficara con ellas.

programme.title: Castle
programme.sub-title: Amar y morir en Los Ángeles
programme.desc: Mientras investiga la muerte de su excompañero en Nueva York, Beckett empieza a pensar que el responsable ha volado a Los Ángeles. A pesar de que tiene órdenes de no hacer nada, la detective vuela hasta Los Ángeles para darle caza y se lleva a Castle. Pronto dan con una pista que les lleva de una piscina en un tejado de Hollywood a la playa de Santa Monica. Por el camino, visitan el set de rodaje de la película que está basada en su libro.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: En la Inglaterra del siglo XIII el arquero Robin Longstride lucha en las Cruzadas al servicio del Rey. Cuando el monarca fallece, Robin se traslada a Nottingham para cumplir una promesa: llevar una espada a Sir Walter Loxley. Será entonces cuando conocerá a Lady Marion.Una especie de precuela de la leyenda de Robin Hood dirigida por Ridley Scott con un presupuesto descomunal de más de 140 millones de euros. El director de ''Blade Runner'' vuelve a confiar en uno de sus actores fetiche, Russell Crowe, que fue escogido dejando de lado otras opciones como Christian Bale o Sam Riley. La cinta bebe claramente de las influencias de la aclamada ''Gladiator'', no solo en cuanto al equipo sino también a nivel de realización y estructura argumental.Scott, que admitió no ser nada apasionado de la leyenda, presionó para modificar substancialmente el guion original. El primer borrador, titulado ''Nottingham'', presentaba a Robin Hood como villano y al Sheriff como un personaje más humanizado. El realizador insistió en acercar el libreto a la versión tradicional de la historia, por lo que el título también fue modificado.

programme.title: La gran muralla
programme.desc: Prisioneros de una unidad de guerreros de élite, los mercenarios europeos William y Tovar se ven envueltos en una cruel batalla contra una horda de criaturas de otro mundo que están atacando la Gran Muralla China.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: La lealtad de James Bond, el mejor agente de los servicios británicos, hacia su superiora M se verá puesta a prueba cuando el pasado de ella vuelve para atormentarla. La tercera entrega de la saga de James Bond con Daniel Craig como protagonista, y la vigesimotercera de toda la serie, fue esta cinta de acción y espionaje, que no sigue ninguna de las historias originales de Ian Fleming. Esta vez, la batuta la llevó Sam Mendes, quien ya había dirigido a Craig en 'Camino a la perdición'. Para el papel de villano, el oscarizado director pensó en otro conocido suyo: Kevin Spacey, protagonista de 'American Beauty', quien tuvo que rechazar la propuesta por incompatibilidad de horarios. Su despiadado rol fue a parar a un Javier Bardem, que ya había impresionado al público estadounidense con su papel de malo en 'No es país para viejos'. Como curiosidad, Craig se pensó si aceptar de nuevo el papel del agente secreto más conocido del planeta, pues ya tenía 43 años y temía no estar físicamente preparado para soportar las dificultosas escenas de acción. Sin embargo, parece ser que sí lo estuvo, pues no solo rompió taquillas, sino que no dudó en volverse a enfundarse el traje de Bond.

programme.title: Spectre
programme.desc: Un críptico mensaje del pasado de Bond le envía tras la pista para descubrir una siniestra organización. Mientras M lucha contra las fuerzas políticas para mantener vivo el servicio secreto, Bond desvela la terrible verdad que se esconde tras SPECTRE.

programme.title: Spectre
programme.desc: Un críptico mensaje del pasado de Bond le envía tras la pista para descubrir una siniestra organización. Mientras M lucha contra las fuerzas políticas para mantener vivo el servicio secreto, Bond desvela la terrible verdad que se esconde tras SPECTRE.

programme.desc: Omar & Fred enflamment le Zénith de Nantes avec une équipe éclectique : DJ Dorion, Jonathan Lambert, Mickaël Gregorio, Elisabeth Buffet, Le Comte de Bouderbala, Phil Darwin et bien d’autres... Une soirée unique où rire et énergie collective sont au rendez-vous.

programme.title: Juste Pour Rire
programme.sub-title: Juste pour Rire avec Eric Antoine et Rachid Badouri
programme.desc: Éric Antoine et Rachid Badouri prennent les commandes d’un gala explosif au Festival Juste pour rire à Montréal. Au programme : une battle déjantée entre humoristes de France et du Québec, avec 8 artistes survoltés prêts à en découdre à coups de sketches et de punchlines. Un face-à-face hilarant entre deux scènes humoristiques cultes, où le rire est le seul vrai gagnant.

programme.title: Juste Pour Rire
programme.sub-title: Comment bien rater ses vacances ? - Best Of Juste Pour Rire
programme.desc: Comment bien rater ses vacances ? Retrouvez le meilleur de Juste Pour Rire présenté par Elisabeth Buffet.

programme.title: Les Étoiles Espoir Humour
programme.sub-title: Les étoiles espoir - Humour du Parisien - 2019
programme.desc: Panayotis Pascot, Doully, Paul Mirabel… Le Parisien réunit ses coups de cœur parmi la jeune génération du rire sur une même scène. Tourné à L’Européen à Paris, ce gala animé par l’imprévisible Monsieur Fraize (premier lauréat du label en 2017) met en lumière neuf talents prometteurs. Chaque humoriste propose un extrait de six minutes, une véritable carte de visite scénique.

programme.title: Derrière un Micro
programme.desc: Derrière un micro s’installe à Bruxelles. Kyan Khojandi y réunit des humoristes francophones venus des deux côtés de la frontière : Baptiste Lecaplain, Guillermo Guiz, Melha Bedia, Doully, Inno JP, Fanny Ruwet, Tareek… Sur la scène du Théâtre du Vaudeville, talents confirmés et nouvelles voix enchaînent sketches et stand-up, mêlant intime et absurde, théâtre et télé, Belgique et France. Un rendez-vous où l’humour efface les frontières.

programme.title: Spectacles
programme.desc: Découvrez les débuts percutants de Christophe Alévêque dans ce spectacle culte enregistré en 1996 au Théâtre de l’Européen. Mis en scène par Dominique Thiel, ce one-man-show rassemble une série de sketchs devenus emblématiques, dont Alerte au flic, Les gonzesses, Le découvert ou encore Le fast-food. Un spectacle qui a marqué le lancement de sa carrière d’humoriste et qui continue de séduire, salué par les spectateurs avec une moyenne de 4,5 étoiles sur 5.

programme.title: Juste Pour Rire
programme.desc: Juste Pour Rire fait son Festival avec Franck Dubosc, Stéphane Rousseau, Anne Roumanoff, Florence Foresti, Jean-Luc Lemoine, Elie Semoun et bien plus encore..

programme.title: Surprise sur prise
programme.desc: L’émission culte qui piège les célébrités grâce à la complicité de leurs proches pour le plus grand plaisir du public. Entre caméras cachées et mises en scène délirantes, Surprise sur prise mêle humour, émotion et surprises inattendues.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant
programme.desc: Monsieur Caravan, commis principal au Ministère de la Marine, habite Courbevoie, avec sa femme et sa vieille mère. Celle-ci meurt subitement. Le docteur Chenet vient constater le décès.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXe siècle
programme.desc: Le comte de Frontac a été ruiné et assassiné. Les enquêteurs ont conclu à des imprudences financières et un suicide. Son fils, Clovis, un artiste dessinateur, n’est pas de cet avis. Son enquête personnelle le conduit à Paris dans un immeuble cossu où il loue une chambre.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXe siècle
programme.desc: Follavoine, fabricant de porcelaine, a mis au point un pot de chambre incassable et compte bien remporter le contrat d’exclusivité pour l’Armée française. Il attend justement Chouilloux, fonctionnaire du Ministère des Armées, qui a la haute décision sur l’attribution du contrat.

programme.title: Les Affaires sont les Affaires
programme.desc: Isidore Lechat, personnage dont la grande richesse n'a d'égal que l'absence totale de scrupules, ne cesse de briser tout ceux qui l'entourent : sa femme, sa fille, ses serviteurs, ses associés, ses ennemis,... C'est ainsi que sa fille décide de s'enfuir loin de lui avec un garçon pauvre.

programme.title: Un autre monde
programme.desc: 1915... A la mort de sa mère, Louis débarque sur l’île de la Réunion pour rencontrer son père le comte de Kerdiguen. L’ile est alors agitée par la mobilisation pour le front. Des planteurs, soutenus par le gouverneur et l’église, tentent d’empêcher le départ de leur main d’oeuvre noire.

programme.title: L'Oncle de Russie
programme.desc: En 1989, le retour de Gaston Boissac, soldat français porté disparu, bouleverse son village. Prisonnier de guerre, il avait été libéré par les troupes soviétiques en 1945 et emmené en URSS, où la guerre froide l’avait bloqué. Ses lettres d'appel au secours n'étaient jamais parvenues à personne.

programme.title: L'Avare - Partie 1
programme.desc: Élise et Cléante, enfants du cupide Harpagon, sont amoureux. Tandis qu’Élise pense à Valère, Cléante est épris de Marianne. Mais Harpagon, uniquement motivé par l'avarice, compte bien unir sa descendance à de riches familles, et épouser lui-même Marianne.

programme.title: Le Bourgeois gentilhomme
programme.desc: En tant que bourgeois, Monsieur Jourdain est déterminé à acquérir les manière d'un homme de qualité. Il décide donc de s'entourer de plusieurs professeurs (maniement des armes, apprentissage de la musique, de la philosophie...).

programme.title: Parle tout bas si c'est d'amour
programme.desc: Une prof de SVT, une grand-mère, des parents en colère et un proviseur : Caroline et Olivier, seize ans, aimeraient que leurs parents et l’Education Nationale cessent de leur parler d’amour. Ils s’aiment, mais ils ont peur de ne pas être à la hauteur. Leur première fois, ils la veulent belle.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Au cours d'un hold up dans une université, un professeur est tué par balle. Un document important est dérobé.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle accompagne Ben à une soirée caritative, Susanne assiste à une rencontre secrète sans le savoir. Elle devient alors la victime d'un coup monté dans lequel elle passe pour la responsable d'un grave accident de la route.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Julia, la soeur de Ben, se marie. Durant la cérémonie, des hommes masqués l'enlèvent. Pensant à une blague, personne ne réagit, mais lorsque Ben reçoit une demande de rançon, plus aucun doute n'est permis. Les soupçons se portent d'abord sur le marié qui doit une forte somme d'argent à un escroc.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.sub-title: S14:E3 La tête dans les étoiles
programme.desc: Ben et Semir enquêtent sur une femme, dans le coma après avoir été assommée. Ils apprennent que cette dernière était femme de ménage dans une société de transports de fonds, où un hold-up a eu lieu. Etait-elle mêlée à ce vol.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Marcus Lahn et Thomas Jakobs commettent un vol dans un hôtel de luxe. Pendant leur fuite, ils sont victimes d'un accident. Marcus est blessé et Thomas prend la fuite. Mais il découvre que le butin a disparu.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Ben et Semir rencontrent Sturmi, un illuminé. D'après lui, un groupe pharmaceutique mène des expérimentations avec un virus mortel.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Sturmi a été victime d'un attentat. Ben et Semir pensent maintenant que ses soupçons sont fondés. Ils décident de se rendre dans le laboratoire pharmaceutique, mais la menace du virus est bien présente.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Ben et Semir tentent d'arrêter un homme appelé "l'Afghan.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Ben remarque des gouttes de sang à l'arrière d'une voiture. Après une course-poursuite, Ben et Semir parviennent à rattraper la voiture mais le conducteur réussit à s'enfuir. A l'intérieur de la voiture, ils découvrent le corps d'un homme qui aurait passé la soirée dans une boite de nuit.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Une jeune fille a dérobé des documents mettant sa vie en danger. Ben et Semir partent à sa recherche pour la protéger.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Une statue est dérobée. La police soupçonne rapidement Alexander Christo et Torsten Brand coutumiers du fait. Au cours de l'enquête, Semir et Ben découvrent une seconde statue qui pourrait intéresser les voleurs.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Des malfrats dérobent une limousine. Ben, chargé de l'enquête, revoit à cette occasion son ancien instructeur.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Claudia Wolters, la fille d'un vieil ami de Herzberger vient d'intégrer l'équipe et doit faire ses preuves.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Après avoir détruit leur voiture de service ainsi que celle de leur chef, Semir et Ben sont chargés de prendre part à une opération de la brigade fluviale pour démanteler un réseau de poseurs de bombes.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra - Un duo explosif
programme.desc: Semir et Ben prennent en chasse une bande de voleurs de voitures de luxe, mais les gangsters réussissent à prendre la fuite.

programme.desc: Faute de moyens, Xue Xiaozhou s’installe par erreur chez Hu Manli, qui transforme la situation en échange de cours pour son fils.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Le cadre d’assurance Ai Linjiang multiplie les avances auprès de Wu Ya, tandis que Hu Manli jongle entre tutorat à domicile et ventes en ligne.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Hu Manli soupçonne à tort son fils Ding Daer de vivre une romance précoce en observant son comportement secret.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Malgré la rupture, Hu Manli aide les proches malades de Ding Zhiyuan à gérer leur séjour hospitalier à Shanghai.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Profitant de difficultés familiales, Qiu Lisu discrédite Ding Zhiyuan lors d’un événement mondain.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Hu Manli replonge dans vingt ans d’archives clients afin de reconstruire son réseau et sa crédibilité.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Xue Xiaozhou hésite entre repli sur soi et évolution sous l’impulsion de Hu Manli.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Hu Manli soutient Ding Daer face à son anxiété liée à une représentation scolaire.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Xue Xiaozhou décroche le titre de meilleur vendeur du trimestre.

programme.title: A Better Life

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: L’échec d’un sinistre multimillionnaire fragilise leur réputation et leur partenariat.

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Chen Fang provoque un affrontement public, obligeant Hu Manli et Xue Xiaozhou à défendre leur intégrité.
